title.hr: Klizni prozor: veličina prozora i brzina
title.en: Sliding window: window size and throughput

concept.hr: Brzina je prozor / kružno vrijeme, a nikad više od brzine veze
concept.en: Throughput is window / round-trip time, never more than the link's rate

summary.hr: Pošiljatelj šalje dok prozor ne napuni, pa veza miruje do potvrde. Mali prozor ili dug put ostavljaju rupe; prozor jednak putu puni vezu.
summary.en: The sender sends until the window is full, then the link idles until an acknowledgment. A small window or long path leaves gaps; one equal to the path fills it.
